mentions.name: MiniHomelabs HWDB
mentions.description: A comparison database for used OEM hardware, described as the PCPartPicker of old PCs for home labbing. It currently focuses on hardware specs and is being expanded to include viable upgrades and explanations of the different model lineups.
mentions.problem: Comparing old PCs for home labbing is harder than it should be.
mentions.audience: It's harder than it should be to compare old pcs for home labbing so I've been building this to scratch my own itch.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://minihomelabs.com/hwdb - Basically the PCPartPicker of used OEM hardware.
